A09.title: 绑定契约IR与输入验证
A09.boundary_and_ownership: Minimal binding-description IR, distinct from SQL/HTTP/domain AST.
A09.native_reuse: Reuse metadata/schema tooling and R05 exporter inventories; no new domain compiler.
A09.csharp_surface: Immutable validated ABI/operation schema with deterministic identifiers and capabilities.
implementation_steps: Specify fixed layouts, import/export names, calling convention, nullability, borrow end, output transfer, thread/reentrancy, error and optional async profile.
Validate unsupported shapes and duplicate symbols before code generation; version schema independently of Engine business metadata.
Emit canonical deterministic description hash and full symbol inventory for A10/A11/drift tests.
Keep source provenance, generating tool version and handwritten/static-descriptor parity.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Unsupported Rust tuples/generics cannot disappear silently from generated exports.
No network/Cargo/database query runs inside compiler generators.
specific_acceptance: Same inputs produce identical IR across processes; malformed/unknown required fields fail with location-bearing diagnostics.
Export inventory negative catches csbindgen silent omission case observed by R05.
A09.dependency_rationale: start pins only actually consumed completed modules; acceptance adds local assembled-runtime checks where required. Reference links alone never become a global barrier.

A10.title: C# LibraryImport绑定发射
A10.boundary_and_ownership: C# static import/callback/owner facade emission; application mapping stays type-safe and AOT-compatible.
A10.native_reuse: Framework LibraryImport generator; compare csbindgen-generated raw imports where useful, never assume its DllImport output equals this profile.
A10.csharp_surface: LibraryImport partial methods, fixed structs and static UCO stubs behind public typed facade.
implementation_steps: Consume A09 validated schema; emit exact managed representation, import calling conventions and private ownership wrappers.
Generate static callback dispatch and cleanup guards using A03–A07 contracts instead of duplicating lifecycle algorithms.
Use incremental semantic inputs with stable equality; never depend on another generator seeing generated source in the same pass.
Package analyzer/compiler-compatible generator separately from net11 runtime facade; keep handwritten-static path equivalent.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Reject nonblittable UCO/ref-like escaping and unsupported target features before runtime.
Generated code must compile warning-clean under trimming/AOT and not use Reflection.Emit or expression compilation.
specific_acceptance: Snapshot plus actual compilation/AOT of empty/generic/public-surface edge cases, deterministic re-run/incremental edits.
Generated imports versus direct native and handcrafted static imports preserve errors/ownership; unsupported symbol negative fails.
A10.dependency_rationale: start pins only actually consumed completed modules; acceptance adds local assembled-runtime checks where required. Reference links alone never become a global barrier.

A11.title: Rust导出与ABI一致性检查
A11.boundary_and_ownership: Maintainer Rust C-export scaffolding and symbol inventory, not application-specific Rust codegen.
A11.native_reuse: csbindgen/cbindgen or source-informed static wrappers per D03 evidence; reuse repr(C)/native owner APIs.
A11.csharp_surface: No public application API; outputs used by native Engine maintainer build.
implementation_steps: Generate or verify exports from the same A09 inventory with unsafe extern/no_mangle rules and exact error/output postconditions.
Wrap actual Engine public APIs; explicitly map unsupported types instead of exporting Rust layout.
Compare produced C header/import/export lists and linker symbols; fail missing or unexpected ABI exports.
Record generator/tool/adapter/upstream identities and make no Cargo invocation from C# entity changes.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: A generator warning with omitted export is a hard inventory failure.
catch_unwind does not justify continuing a poisoned Engine or freeing memory through a different allocator.
specific_acceptance: C/Rust/C# signatures/layout parity, changed-source drift rejection and negative unsupported tuple/generic cases.
Build and execute exports on Windows MSVC and Linux GNU with final linked symbol inventories.
A11.dependency_rationale: start pins only actually consumed completed modules; acceptance adds local assembled-runtime checks where required. Reference links alone never become a global barrier.

A12.title: ABI、生命周期与AOT分析器
A12.boundary_and_ownership: Static diagnostics for known ABI/AOT/ownership hazards; no assertion that analysis proves arbitrary unsafe code safe.
A12.native_reuse: Roslyn incremental analyzer/semantic model, framework AOT diagnostics; no runtime analysis service.
A12.csharp_surface: Actionable NW diagnostic IDs with source spans, severity, explanation and local fix where sound.
implementation_steps: Implement D03 diagnostic set: unsupported wire types, invalid callback signatures, escaped borrow/ref-like values, missing required schema and conflicting export IDs.
Detect forbidden generator side effects/build hooks and unsupported dynamic reflection paths in owned surface where statically knowable.
Use compilation cancellation correctly and avoid retaining Compilation/Symbol graphs globally.
Document false-positive limits and narrow reviewed suppressions; unsupported uncertainty must not emit unsafe code.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Analyzer cancellation discards unpublished results and retains no user compilation objects.
Do not label absence of diagnostics as ownership/concurrency proof.
specific_acceptance: Positive/negative source tests with exact diagnostic spans, incremental edits and cancellation; no tests that merely mirror implementation branches.
Real Native AOT compile verifies analyzer guidance does not hide framework warnings.
A12.dependency_rationale: start pins only actually consumed completed modules; acceptance adds local assembled-runtime checks where required. Reference links alone never become a global barrier.
